name: Fountain of Colors
description: Reference-based Ubuntu GNOME adaptation with live native widgets.

reference.creator: alatsombath
reference.fidelity: Independent reference-based adaptation; not a pixel-identical or complete Windows suite port.
notes: The 80 live FFT bars and fading peaks use CAVA’s system-playback monitor.
Default palette follows the current creator preview. Rainmeter’s full settings skin and wallpaper-color extraction are replaced by editable theme data.

wallpaper.credit: Original AI-generated wallpaper created for this repository with OpenAI image_gen, 2026-11-03.
